# Content Management Phase Gate — verify complete list, index, log, enhanced delete contract

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Gate Note
summary: Note for content management verification
tags: test
---
Gate note content.
-- note-input.md --

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Second Gate Note
summary: Another note for verification
tags: test
---
Second gate note content.
-- note2-input.md --

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Gate Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for content management verification
tags: test
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
Gate ADR content.
-- adr-input.md --

-- append-input.md --
Appended content line.
-- append-input.md --

# === SETUP ===

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# === WRITE AND LIST ===

exec akb write gate-note.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/gate-note.md'

exec akb write second-note.md <../note2-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/second-note.md'

exec akb write gate-decision.md <../adr-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/gate-decision.md'

# List shows all pages alphabetically
exec akb list
stdout 'decisions/gate-decision.md'
stdout 'notes/gate-note.md'
stdout 'notes/second-note.md'

# List excludes index.md and log.md
exec akb list
! stdout 'index.md'
! stdout 'log.md'

# List strips kb/ prefix
exec akb list
! stdout 'kb/'

# === INDEX ADD AND SHOW ===

exec akb index add kb/notes/gate-note.md "Gate note summary"
stdout 'Added kb/notes/gate-note.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout '## Notes'
stdout 'Gate Note'
stdout 'gate-note.md'

# === INDEX ADD UPDATES EXISTING ===

exec akb index add kb/notes/gate-note.md "Updated gate summary"
stdout 'Added kb/notes/gate-note.md to index'

exec akb index show
stdout 'Updated gate summary'
! stdout 'Gate note summary'

# === INDEX REMOVE ===

exec akb index remove kb/notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'Removed kb/notes/gate-note.md from index'

exec akb index show
! stdout 'gate-note.md'

# === INDEX REBUILD ===

exec akb index add kb/notes/gate-note.md "Rebuild test"
exec akb index add kb/notes/second-note.md "Second note"
exec akb index add kb/decisions/gate-decision.md "Gate decision"

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb index show
stdout 'Gate Note'
stdout 'Second Gate Note'
stdout 'Gate Decision'

# === LOG APPEND AND SHOW ===

exec akb log append ingest "Ingested all pages" --title "Initial Ingest"

exec akb log show
stdout 'ingest'
stdout 'Initial Ingest'
stdout 'Ingested all pages'

# === LOG SHOW --LAST ===

exec akb log append update "Updated a page"

exec akb log show --last 1
stdout 'Updated a page'
! stdout 'Initial Ingest'

# === LOG SHOW --TYPE ===

exec akb log show --type ingest
stdout 'Ingested all pages'
! stdout 'Updated a page'

# === LOG INVALID OPERATION ===

! exec akb log append invalid "Bad operation"
stderr 'invalid operation'

# === DELETE WITH INDEX AND LOG ===

# Re-add to index for delete test
exec akb index add kb/notes/gate-note.md "Before delete"

exec akb delete notes/gate-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/gate-note.md'

# File removed
! exists kb/notes/gate-note.md

# Index entry removed
exec akb index show
! stdout 'gate-note.md'

# Log has delete entry
exec akb log show --type delete
stdout 'delete'

# === DELETE PAGE NOT IN INDEX ===

exec akb write unindexed.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/unindexed.md'

# Delete succeeds even without index entry
exec akb delete notes/unindexed.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/unindexed.md'

! exists kb/notes/unindexed.md

# === DELETE MANAGED FILES BLOCKED ===

! exec akb delete index.md
stderr 'cannot delete index.md'

! exec akb delete log.md
stderr 'cannot delete log.md'

! exec akb delete kb/index.md
stderr 'cannot delete index.md'

! exec akb delete kb/log.md
stderr 'cannot delete log.md'

# === STATUS PAGE COUNT ===

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 2'

# Delete one page
exec akb delete notes/second-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/second-note.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 1'

# === CORE I/O STILL WORKS ===

# Write still works
exec akb write verify-note.md <../note-input.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/verify-note.md'

# Read still works
exec akb read verify-note.md
stdout 'Gate Note'

# Append still works
exec akb append notes/verify-note.md <../append-input.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/verify-note.md'

exec akb read verify-note.md
stdout 'Appended content line.'

# Basic delete still works
exec akb delete notes/verify-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/verify-note.md'

! exists kb/notes/verify-note.md
